body:
### Fixed
- Fixed the handling of SV modifying commands (`prepareSvReload`, `prepareSvDebit`) when the secure session is automatically split because the card modifications buffer would overflow (multiple session mode): the SV Get command(s) are now replayed in the new secure session just before the SV command, and the SV related session flags now apply to the session in which the SV command is actually executed. Previously, the SV signature could not be checked at session closing and a second SV operation could be accepted in the new session (CL-SV-1PCSS.1).
### Changed
- `prepareSvReload` and `prepareSvDebit` now throw an `IllegalStateException` if the last command prepared, or processed with the channel kept open, is not an SV Get command, in accordance with CL-SV-GETDEBIT.1 and CL-SV-GETRLOAD.1. Sequences where another command, including an Open Secure Session, is inserted between `prepareSvGet` and the SV modifying command are no longer allowed.
